$Comment: Jack's Confidant: reach Revered with Old Jack, the rank his reputation calls Confidant.
Earned once and kept. Favor with Old Jack carries from one Hallow's Eve to the next, so this
file has no Parent: the yearly skeleton would mint a copy each year that every Revered player
collects again at login for nothing. It carries no hallowed tag either, which keeps it out of
The Hallowed. REPUTATION_RANK credits every rank a player's favor has reached, gear included,
each time their favor or their gear changes and when they log in, so wearing the Jack Helm can
earn this too. Target is the rank id and Qualifier the reputation id. The criterion's TextKey
words the step with Old Jack's own rank name. It pays the title Hallows_Eve_Jacks_Confidant
